summary: Plain kerb on a wide road beside a sports field, with cars parked nearby.
reasons: Field and trees on the van side
Plain kerb on a busy wide road
Homes across road, 19 m or more

drivers.seclusion: Trees and an open sports field behind the kerb; nearest dwellings are across the wide road, 19 to 23 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars sit at the kerb just beyond the start and one beside it, so room to stop is likely; the kerb lane itself looks narrow.
drivers.traffic: Wide road with several marked lanes and a junction nearby; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: A few cars parked on this kerb at the top end, but none along most of the stretch; no obvious overnight convention.

flags: Bus Zone signs on the far side 9 m from the line; check which kerb they cover
Slightly steep in places: 4.5% max grade, mean 1.7%
Low-lying: 4.0 to 5.3 m elevation, Toowong Creek 154 m away
Club car park beside the kerb is marked customers only
sun_shade: Tree belt along the field edge shades the section from the east in the morning; open to the west in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the Bus Zone applies to this kerb

best_section.where: South-east kerb of Indooroopilly Road, by the tree belt at the field's edge
